Subject: Kickoff: Vendor setup & privacy items needed for Silverline Tech

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're starting procurement intake on the Silverline engagement so that Finance and Security can create a vendor record and issue a PO. To keep things moving, can you please provide the items below by EOD Tuesday (US PDT) if possible?

Checklist (what we need from Silverline):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we've attached our standard word template)
- Confirmation whether you can sign our DPA (we share a standard DPA + security annex)
- Current list of subprocessors with country and data processing purpose (CSV preferred)
- Data retention policy: retention periods for customer content, logs, and backups
- Evidence of security posture (SOC 2 report or ISO cert, redacted is fine)
- Banking details & remit instructions (can be shared via secure portal link)
- Preferred billing terms (Net30 is standard for us; let us know if you need different terms)

Operational notes: once we have the above, Finance will create a vendor code and raise a PO. Our procurement / AP contact is Laura (cc'd) and karthik will pick up technical onboarding and any associated security questions.

Attachments: silverline_vendor_onboarding_form.docx (fill and return)

If you prefer, we can also set up a 20-minute call tomorrow to run through the checklist.

Thanks —

Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clear checklist. I'm attaching the completed onboarding form and a first-pass subprocessors export. Quick answers inline below, more detail in attachments:

- DPA: Silverline is able to sign a standard DPA with a security annex. We typically sign via DocuSign; I'll include a link in my next message.
- Subprocessors: attached as subprocessors_2026-04-05.csv. It includes our cloud provider, analytics vendor, and a small set of monitoring subvendors (names + processing purpose).
- Data retention: we retain customer content for 365 days by default; audit logs for 180 days; encrypted backups retained for compliance purposes for up to 7 years.
- SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 report (attached).
- Banking details: we'll provide banking/ACH info via our vendor portal (link below) — we avoid sending banking details over email.

Attachments: silverline_vendor_onboarding_form.docx (completed), subprocessors_2026-04-05.csv, Silverline_SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

Thanks, Elena — this is great progress. A couple of clarifying items from Security/Onboarding side before we create the PO:

1) DPA: can you confirm you accept Redwood's standard DPA + security annex? If there are redline requests, please flag them in the DocuSign review so we can route to Legal quickly. We typically need a signed DPA before production keys are issued.

2) Subprocessors: the CSV is helpful — can you include the subprocessors' country of operation and whether each subprocess handles customer content vs telemetry? We ask for that level to satisfy our dataflow mapping.

3) Evidence: the SOC 2 redacted report is fine. If you also have an AICPA bridge letter or ISO/IEC cert, please share.

4) Retention: please break out retention by category (customer content, logs, backups) and state whether customers can request deletion earlier than the default retention period.

5) PO & invoice process: Laura, can you confirm Redwood's invoice remit and whether we require a separate W-9 / tax form for US vendors?

Hannah: once we get the clarified subprocessors and signed DPA, Security will approve for production onboarding and we'll create the vendor code.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Applied ML — Onboarding
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_vendor_template.docx]
